prompt: Live-action cinematic movie footage, lifelike photographic materials, physical practical-effects transformation in a single continuous shot. On a dark timber workbench a tiny ivory origami paper boat floats in living reflecting water. Its triangular folded paper opens, stretches and billows into woven cream canvas sails. Its angular paper hull continuously expands and curves into a polished dark mahogany hull, revealing brass hardware and rope rigging. The one boat grows into a full-size twelve-meter sailing yacht. Camera continuously pulls back as the water expands into an immense ocean and the workbench disappears below it. The same yacht rides natural deep-blue ocean waves, throwing bow spray under a beautiful sunrise. Detailed paper fibres, wet timber grain, canvas weave, curved living waves, cinematic lighting, reflections and ocean mist. Preserve the reference continuous camera and geometry transformation.
